item.title: Version 0.4.2
item.description:
Added

  • First-time onboarding tip for RevenueCat. On first launch, a small popover anchored to the toolbar RevenueCat icon explains how to connect — and reminds you that keys are per-project (each app you track needs its own).

Changed

  • Faster table loads on per-app views. A single app’s table now requests only its own campaigns from Apple Ads instead of fetching the whole org and filtering client-side.
  • Long date ranges (>~90 days) now render correctly. Apple Ads rejects daily granularity for those spans; ADSwift falls back to weekly/monthly bucketing automatically. Aggregate values (spend, taps, etc.) stay exact — only inline sparkline resolution changes.
  • Trend sparkline column hides when it can’t be drawn (Today / Yesterday, and ranges over ~90 days) instead of filling the row with em-dashes.

Fixed

  • Empty or errored metric cells no longer shimmer forever. Campaigns, ad groups, and keywords with no spend in the selected range now render as zero, and a failed Apple Ads request leaves cells in a “no data” state.
  • Custom date range pickers no longer trigger duplicate RevenueCat re-aggregations on selection — three coalesced into one.
  • Per-app metrics cache is now keyed by scope, so an All-Campaigns view can’t inherit the previous app’s narrowed cache.
